title: Just Juice Kiwi & Cranberry on Ice Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Conjure a colada cocktail for your taste buds with this premium e-liquid from Just Juice. Ripe, exotic kiwifruit lend their tropical sweetness to the tingly tartness of cranberries, and all shot through with an invigorating icy kick for an irresistible fruity vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
